{"filepath": "solar_research.md", "content": "# Solar Panel Efficiency, Technologies, and Market Trends (2025–2026)

This report provides an overview of current data, statistics, and technological developments in the solar energy sector for 2026.

## 1. Solar Panel Efficiency and Technologies
Commercial solar panel efficiency has continued to rise, driven by advancements in cell architectures:
- **TOPCon (Tunnel Oxide Passivated Contact):** Rapidly displacing older PERC technology as the commercial standard. TOPCon modules offer efficiencies typically ranging from **22.5% to 25%** at a cost-effective price point.
- **HJT (Heterojunction Technology):** Represents one of the most efficient options for residential and commercial use, delivering commercial module efficiencies between **24% and 26%**, alongside superior temperature performance.
- **Perovskite-Silicon Tandem Cells:** Pushing research and lab efficiency boundaries higher, with commercial pilot production scaling up in 2025/2026.

## 2. Key Market Trends
- **Bifacial Panels:** Increasingly becoming the default standard for ground-mounted and large-scale commercial installations.
- **Larger-Format Wafers:** Adoption of M10 and G12 wafer formats continues to drive down system cost-per-watt.
- **Smart & Integrated Systems:** Rising deployment of integrated battery-ready solutions and AI-driven performance monitoring systems.
